qualification: SSC / 10th Standard or equivalent with Science subjects, with a minimum of 55% marks in aggregate AND ITI certificate / National or State Trade Certificate (NTC/STC) in Laboratory Assistant (Chemical Plant) trade OR 2 years full-time apprenticeship experience in Lab Assistant (Chemical Plant) trade OR 3 years work experience in Lab Assistant (Chemical Plant) trade in Government/PSU/Autonomous body.
salary: Posts carry usual allowances such as Dearness Allowance (DA), House Rent Allowance (HRA), and Transport Allowance (TA) admissible to central government employees as applicable to CSIR. Council employees are also eligible for accommodation as per CSIR allotment rules.
age_limit: The upper age limits for various posts are 30 years for Technical Officer, 35 years for Security Officer, 28 years for Security Assistant, 28 years for Technician (1), and 25 years for Multi-Tasking Staff. The crucial date for determining the upper age limit, qualifications, and experience is 06.11.2026 for Post Codes TO-01 to TO-05 and TC-01 to TC-04, and 16.11.2026 for Post Codes SO-01, SA-01, and MTS-01. The applicant's age must not be below 18 years.
application_fee: The application fee must be paid online through SBI Collect / online payment gateway. Fee is non-refundable.
selection_process: The selection process varies by post category and generally involves screening, trade tests, physical tests, personality assessment tests, and competitive written examinations. || Technical Officer:Screening Committee recommendation followed by a qualifying Trade Test and a competitive Written Examination comprising Paper I (Mental Ability Test, 50 Qs, 100 Marks), Paper II (General Awareness & English Language, 50 Qs, 150 Marks), and Paper III (Concerned Subject, 100 Qs, 300 Marks). Final merit is based on Paper II and III. || Security Officer:Screening followed by Physical Standards, Physical Test, and a Written Examination consisting of Paper-I (Mental Ability & Personality Assessment, 100 Qs, 100 Marks) and Paper-II (Subjective: Comprehension, Report Writing, Security Regulations & Firefighting, General Awareness, 100 Marks). || Security Assistant:Screening, qualifying Skill / Physical and Personality Assessment Test (100 Qs, 100 Marks), followed by a subjective Competitive Written Examination (100 Marks). || Technician (1):Trade Test followed by a competitive Written Examination comprising Paper I (Mental Ability Test, 50 Qs, 100 Marks), Paper II (General Awareness & English Language, 50 Qs, 150 Marks), and Paper III (Concerned Subject, 50 Qs, 150 Marks). || Multi-Tasking Staff:Competitive Written Examination consisting of General Intelligence (25 Qs, 75 Marks), Quantitative Aptitude (25 Qs, 75 Marks), General Awareness (50 Qs, 150 Marks), and English Language (50 Qs, 150 Marks). Total 150 questions, 300 marks.
